objection: The solution is too expensive compared to traditional human SDRs.
content: Handling: While human SDRs cost approximately $65,000 to $85,000 annually with benefits, equipment, and management overhead (equating to over $35/hour), Fortivex AI operates at less than $0.10 per qualified lead conversation with 24/7 availability. Customers typically achieve an 80% reduction in customer acquisition cost while capturing 100% of after-hours leads.

objection: We already have an in-house sales team, so we do not need AI.
content: Handling: Fortivex AI is designed to augment and empower your human sales team, not replace them. By automating repetitive tier-1 lead qualification and calendar booking, your human account executives only speak with pre-qualified, high-intent prospects, multiplying their closing productivity by 3x.

objection: AI voice agents sound robotic and will frustrate our buyers.
content: Handling: Fortivex AI uses state-of-the-art neural speech synthesis with expressive prosody, natural breathing cues, and dynamic emotional tone adaptation. Coupled with sub-400ms latency and intelligent interruption handling, buyers frequently cannot distinguish the agent from a human representative.

objection: We are worried about data privacy and proprietary data leaks.
content: Handling: Security is our highest priority. We sign comprehensive Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) and enterprise Data Processing Agreements (DPAs). Data is siloed per tenant, encrypted with customer-managed keys, and never shared or used for foundational model training.

metadata.value_proposition: Tenant isolation, zero model training, BAA/DPA
